relationships.subject: pravadoline
relationships.evidence_quote: Pravadoline, comprised of an indole nucleus with an alkylamine substituent extending from the indole N, was a cyclooxygenase inhibitor like NSAIDS and blocked the formation of prostaglandins

relationships.subject: WIN55212-2
relationships.evidence_quote: We can conclude that both common brain anatomic distribution patterns and behavioral similarities in rodent models demonstrate that the analgesic AAI compounds indeed bind to and stimulate the brain cannabinoid receptors.

relationships.subject: WIN55212-2
relationships.evidence_quote: WIN56098 evoked competitive antagonism of the mouse vas deferens inhibition by pravadoline, the naphthoyl analog, and WIN55212-2, as well as inhibition of brain adenylyl cyclase by WIN55212-2

key_findings: Aminoalkylindole analgesics (pravadoline, WIN55212-2) were found to act at the CB1 cannabinoid receptor rather than via COX inhibition or opioid receptors.
Computational and SAR studies indicate AAI and cannabinoid ligands overlap in the CB1 binding pocket but with partly distinct interactions.
